node.label: 属性断言：System type is a robust property with respect to parameter changes in the unity feedback structure. For example, if the process parameters change without removing the pole at the origin in a Type 1 system, the velocity constant will change but the system will still have zero steady-state error in response to a constant input and will still be Type 1.
